lines.en: Let me rub some cream on your wart.
Oh, that'd be nice.
Mom, are you down here?
I can get out!
My baby, are you all right?
Oh, no!
Hey! Don't get any blood on my floor!
My son is hurt, what's wrong with you?
For one thing, I got a wart that needs cream on it.
Take your lemon home and give it a bath.
Look, I just aim like this.
- No, I don't want you to-- - Hey, Carly, look.
I brought you--
Kids!
All right, don't try to intimidate me.
I am a citizen of Seattle and I am taking these kids home right now
because I told them-- Oh God, I'm afraid.
Wait!
- Bring in the muffin basket. - Copy that.
What? Hey, who's this for?
Hey! Hey!
Give me a hug!
Punch me!
The muffin basket is in place.
Muffins?
Well, don't mind if I do!
And now, time for a confetti surprise!
Hit it!
*Screams*
